---
title: "report-main-failure.yml"
---

Follow up when a workflow fails on the default branch.
Call it from a `workflow_run` stub; see `examples/report-main-failure.yml`.

- A cancelled or skipped run is ignored.
- A first-attempt failure whose failed jobs all look like infrastructure
  (failed in set-up or checkout, or no step failed) is re-run once, and no
  issue is filed.
- Any other failure files or updates one issue per workflow, titled
  `Main CI failing: <workflow>`, through the same deduplication as
  [`report-failure.yml`](report-failure.qmd).
  A second infrastructure-looking failure carries the `infra-suspect` label.
- A success on the default branch comments on that issue with the green run
  and closes it.

## Inputs

| Input    | Type   | Default | Description                                                                                                                                  |
| -------- | ------ | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `labels` | string | `''`    | Comma-separated labels for a newly filed issue. Labels the repository does not define are dropped with a warning rather than failing the report. |

## Permissions

Grant `issues: write` to file and close the issue,
and `actions: write` to re-run the failed jobs,
on the calling job and nothing else.
The job performs no checkout, so it needs no `contents` grant.

## Example

`workflow_run` takes workflow names, not globs, so list each workflow to watch.

```yaml
name: Report main failure

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [Check links, Quarto Publish]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  report:
    permissions:
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/report-main-failure.yml@v3
```
